verdict.rationale: The single OCR endpoint documents PDF, PPTX, DOCX and images (PNG, JPEG, AVIF) through `document_url`/`image_url`, so a large part of the mix goes through one API. XLSX, HTML and email are not named; the docs only say "other document formats." Community reports cover PDF-to-markdown and scanned or handwritten images, not the other formats. Missing for 10: explicit XLSX, HTML and email (EML/MSG) support, a complete supported-format list, and independent hands-on corroboration for non-PDF Office formats.
